summary: Cellectis S.A. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing upcoming clinical data presentations at the EHA 2026 annual congress for its CAR-T cell therapies lasme-cel and eti-cel. The filing reports on the BALLI-01 Phase 1 results and NATHALI-01 study, with no mention of any merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or other special situation transaction. There are no deal terms, financial details, board recommendations, or advisor names provided. The filing is a routine update on clinical trial progress typical for a biotech company.
